dct_title_s: Damage Assessment in Sagaing Township, Sagaing District, Sagaing Region, Myanmar as of 30 March 2025
dct_description_sm: **UNOSAT code: EQ20250328MMR, GDACS ID: 1474477** This map illustrates the potentially damaged structures/buildings affected by the March 28, 2025, earthquake in Mandalay. The analysis focuses on a part of Sagaing Township, Sagaing District, Sagaing Region, where damage was detected using a Pleiades very high-resolution satellite image acquired on March 30, 2025, at 11:01 local time. UNOSAT identified 233 damaged structures and 557 potentially damaged ones. This is a preliminary analysis and has not yet been validated in the field. Please send ground feedback to the United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT).
